summary: A modest but coherent two-step tangent refinement with supported development gains and real prospective E5 improvements against the declared Converter/ridge configurations. Weak accept for the useful scoped contribution; independent nDCG advantage over the strongest geometric baseline is not demonstrated.
strengths_ranked: Correct, explicit norm-scaled cosine-gradient target and compact affine accumulation, without claiming guaranteed finite-step improvement.
Matched development evidence supports +0.0243 nDCG over Procrustes and +0.0069 from the second correction; prospective E5 gains against Converter/ridge persist across budgets.
Exact retrieval, anchor-inclusive accounting, five seeds, approximate family intervals, development/test distinction and negative results are explicit.
Mixed-gallery diagnostics establish meaningful replacement effects without claiming that partial backfilling itself is new.

weaknesses_ranked.finding: No independently confirmed nDCG improvement over Procrustes; its point mean is higher in all six prospective cells.
Incremental novelty; ARC2-versus-ridge changes the prior/initialization as well as tangent targeting.
Only one prospective 50-query collection and two dimensionality-matched encoder transitions; no deployment measurements, and Full-X remains stronger on all partial-development means.
Adapted neural baseline training/selection bounds the meaning of large gains; HMoE is not evaluated and public artifact access remains pending.

strongest_rejection_argument: The procedure is an incremental refinement whose advantage over the strongest simple alignment baseline occurs on development evidence. The only prospective collection gives Procrustes higher nDCG in all six cells; large confirmed gains are against weaker adapted configurations. Thus the new refinement has limited independent evidence of advancing the best migration operating point.
required_current_claim_fixes: Replace the pending artifact notice with an accessible anonymous package supplying the promised baseline settings, revisions, protocol locks and analysis entry points.
minimum_response: Explicitly acknowledge the unresolved prospective nDCG comparison with Procrustes, already disclosed in the body, and retain the distinction between the full initialized refinement and an isolated tangent-specific effect.
experiment_decision_reason: The narrow descriptive development, second-step, held configuration-specific, cross-budget and coefficient-storage claims are supported by the inspected evidence. No fatal current-claim inconsistency was found.
optional_extensions: Additional independently locked collections and encoder transitions
Supervision-size study with matched effective regularization
